chart.text: Synthetic SWOG assignment record: assigned to S1900J through LUNGMAP.
Pathology confirms recurrent metastatic non-small cell lung adenocarcinoma. FMI tissue NGS confirms MET amplification.

Diagnostic CT documents a measurable 3.2 cm lung lesion outside all previous radiation ports. All known disease sites are documented on the Baseline Tumor Assessment Form; no additional non-measurable lesions.
Screening brain MRI: no brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.
No CNS metastases. Neurologically asymptomatic; no systemic corticosteroids.
FMI tissue NGS: no other actionable oncogenic alterations, including EGFR sensitizing/T790M, MET exon-14 skipping, ALK, ROS1, RET, NTRK, HER2, KRAS and BRAF V600E.
Treating oncologist documents radiographic progression after the most recent systemic line.

Complete reconciled treatment history: one prior line of carboplatin, pemetrexed and pembrolizumab for metastatic NSCLC; final dose 70 days before the demo registration date. No other systemic cancer therapy ever received.
All prior treatment toxicities resolved to grade 0. No ongoing adverse effects.
Complete reconciled oncology history: never received any MET tyrosine kinase inhibitor, including tepotinib, capmatinib or crizotinib, for any cancer.
Complete reconciled treatment administration history: last systemic cancer treatment 70 days before demo registration; no treatment since.
Complete reconciled treatment administration history: last pembrolizumab 70 days before demo registration; no other anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy since.
Complete reconciled radiation history: never received radiation therapy.
Treating oncologist documents no planned concurrent chemotherapy, immunotherapy, biologic or hormonal cancer treatment.
No major surgery or significant traumatic injury in the preceding year; no unrecovered procedure; no surgery planned during study participation. Port insertion was uncomplicated.
Treating oncologist confirms no prior or concurrent malignancy other than NSCLC.
Absolute neutrophil count 2.3 x10^3/uL.
Hemoglobin 11.5 g/dL.
Platelets 180 x10^3/uL.
Total bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL; institutional ULN 1.2 mg/dL. No history of Gilbert syndrome.
AST 20 U/L (ULN 40 U/L); ALT 22 U/L (ULN 40 U/L). No liver metastases.
Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; institutional ULN 1.2 mg/dL. Specimen collected and processed today.
Zubrod performance status 1.
Complete medical history and physical examination performed today.
No known cardiac disease, no cardiac symptoms and no prior cardiotoxic agent exposure. Clinical risk assessment documents NYHA class I.
HIV testing negative; no known HIV infection.
HBV testing negative; no chronic hepatitis B infection.
HCV antibody and RNA negative; no prior hepatitis C infection.
Investigator reviewed medical history: no diabetes.
Patient is 68 years old, postmenopausal for 16 years; no reproductive potential.
Investigator confirms no clinically active infectious liver disease.
Blood pressure 122/74 mmHg; investigator confirms no clinically significant hypertension.
Complete pulmonary history: no pneumonitis requiring drug therapy, no active symptomatic ILD or pneumonitis.
Investigator finds no ongoing or active infection or diagnosed or suspected viral infection. No antimicrobial therapy.
Investigator confirms no active bleeding diathesis.
Room air oxygen saturation 97%; investigator confirms no impaired oxygenation requiring continuous supplementation.
Investigator assessment: no psychiatric, social or other circumstance currently limiting adherence to study requirements.
Investigator confirms no unstable ophthalmologic condition.
Postmenopausal for 16 years; not pregnant or breastfeeding; no reproductive potential. Future consent discussion remains pending.
